entities.notes: The level exit. It is mirrored by default, snaps to nearby ground, opens when Ignatius approaches, and walks him through before loading its destination level.

entities.letterTitle: A Letter from Your Humble Editor
entities.letterText:
Dear Ignatius,

I heard of your difficulties getting your book published.

Maybe the world isn't ready for your ideas on "Turbulent fuel/oxidizer intermix".

But have you considered writing something else?  

I am looking for someone to write a travelbook - there is lots of money in those!

Easy and pleasant work too - just travel somewhere nice and take notes.

I hear the caverns to the east might be a real tourist magnet.

Sincerely,
Wilfred of Bittervine, Esq
Editor
entities.thoughtText:
A travelbook?

Well, at least I will get SOMETHING published.

Besides a trip seem nice. I could do with a vacation.
entities.notes: An editor-letter mailbox. Each placed mailbox owns its own trigger distance, letter, thought, and timing metadata, so a level can contain several tutorial letters.

entities.letterTitle: A Letter from Your Humble Editor
entities.letterText:
Careful, my last researcher fell down here.

He was a cocky guy and claimed to be able to jump large distances by pushing off a second time mid-air.

But thats insane! 

One would have to be some kind of wizard to try that - or at least have a jetpack.

/Wilfred of Bittervine, Esq
entities.thoughtText:
Drats!  

I was sick the day they taught us floating charms.

Hmmm....  "Jetpack" he said. 

And something about jumping mid air.
entities.notes: An editor-letter mailbox. Each placed mailbox owns its own trigger distance, letter, thought, and timing metadata, so a level can contain several tutorial letters.

entities.thoughtText:
This must be the entrance to the caverns.

No turning back now.

entities.thoughtText:
My old target dummy!

Maybe I should practice one last time on firing my rocket.

What button was it now again?
entities.notes: Invisible one-shot region that pauses play and shows an Ignatius thought bubble when entered.

entities.thoughtText:
I see a little fella over there. 

I bet we'll be friends!
